description: October 9 birthday meaning: Libra decan 2, birthday number 9, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an October 9 birthday falls in Libra, in the second decan, with Venus as the sign's ruler and Uranus as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 9. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Libra is cardinal and air.

sections.heading: Personality of an October 9 birthday
paragraphs: Halfway through Libra, the Sun of October 9 sits at fifteen degrees, in the decan Uranus sub-rules. The sign's sense of justice meets Aquarian ideals here, and the birthday number 9 amplifies that humanitarian impulse. Traditionally, this is a date of causes and campaigns: a gracious activist who prefers changing minds through conversation rather than confrontation.

By noon UTC on October 9, the Sun has normally reached roughly 15° of Libra. That places the date in the Libra decan that astrologers give to Uranus, the second of three. The middle stretch of Libra, roughly October 3 to October 13, takes Uranus as sub-ruler, the planet associated with Aquarius in modern astrology. This tends to turn the sign's interest in fairness towards society at large. Natives are often pictured as idealistic, progressive and drawn to groups, networks and causes. Their relationships may be unconventional, or built on friendship and shared values more than tradition. Uranus brings originality and also a cool, detached streak when emotions run high. Combining their sense of justice with personal warmth usually helps them persuade rather than simply be right.

sections.heading: Numerology of the October 9 birthday
paragraphs: Born on the 9th, your birthday number is 9, the last and broadest of the single digits. Numerologists see the birth day as a secondary number that describes a natural gift. The 9 is traditionally associated with compassion, idealism and a wide view of humanity, perhaps because it contains something of every number before it. Those with this birthday often find themselves helping, teaching or creating for audiences beyond their own circle. Letting go can be a recurring theme for 9s, along with learning that finishing one chapter makes space for a better one.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same October 9 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 1 for 1980, 11 for 1990, 3 for 2000 and 4 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: October 9 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: October birthdays fall in mid-autumn north of the equator, with turning leaves and earlier evenings, and in mid-spring in the southern hemisphere. Libra holds most of the month, with Scorpio arriving around October 23. In numerology October is month 10, which reduces to 1: a number of new starts and independence, carried here with a 0 that is often read as amplifying it. October 9 is the 282nd day of the year (283rd in a leap year). In most years Scorpio season is under way by October 24, 15 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for an October 9 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. October 9 is also the birthday of John Lennon (1940), David Cameron (1966) and Léopold Sédar Senghor (1906).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is October 9?
faq.answer: October 9 is Libra in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Libra, which tradition links with Uranus.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on October 9?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On October 9 the Life Path is 8 in 1960, 9 in 1970, 1 in 1980, 11 in 1990, 3 in 2000, 4 in 2010 and 5 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 9 for everyone born on the 9th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on October 9?
faq.answer: By October 9 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on October 9?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with an October 9 birthday are John Lennon (1940), David Cameron (1966) and Léopold Sédar Senghor (1906). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
